items.exampleEn: I want to learn to swim.
You can find information on the internet.
items.exampleZh: 你可以在網路上找到資訊。

items.exampleEn: I read the newspaper every morning.

items.sentenceEn: I learn ten new words every day.

items.audioEn: Let's study at the library. They have a lot of history books.
items.audioZh: 我們去圖書館讀書吧，那裡有很多歷史書。
items.questionZh: 說話者為什麼想去圖書館讀書？

items.sentenceEn: I have an idea. Let's go to the zoo.
items.sentenceZh: 我有個主意，我們去動物園吧。

items.sentenceEn: I study history at the library.

items.stemEn: I don't know this ____. What does it mean?
items.stemZh: 我不認識這個字，它是什麼意思？

items.stemEn: Going to the beach is a good ____.

items.passageEn: Mia loves history. She reads history books every night. She wants to learn about old cities and kings. On the weekend, she goes to the library to find more information. Her dream is to become a history teacher one day.
items.passageZh: Mia 很喜歡歷史，她每天晚上都讀歷史書。她想了解古老的城市和國王。週末她會去圖書館找更多資料。她的夢想是有一天當歷史老師。

questions.questionZh: Mia 週末去圖書館做什麼？

referenceEn: I learn five new words every day.
Every day, I learn five new words.
rubricZh: 「學」可用 learn 或 study（例如 learn new words）
數量大於一，word 用複數 words
每天做的事用現在簡單式

items.instructionZh: 用 read 造一個句子，說說你喜歡讀什麼或什麼時候讀。
referenceEn: I read the news on my phone every morning.
I like to read books before bed.
rubricZh: read 後面接讀的東西（例如 read books、read the news）
時態配合內容（例如習慣用現在簡單式）
